d:
Kangres sansdiy dal ki adhyaksh soniya gandhi ke nae sansmaran/kitab men 'indiya' gathbandhan ki baithkon aur bihar ke mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke gathbandhan se alag hone ke sandarbh men ki gaee tippaniyon par janta dal yunaited (JDU) ke karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha ne tikha palatvar kiya hai.
Sanjay jha ke pramukh bindu aur tikhe prahar:
Kangres ka ghatiya kalchar: sanjay jha ne kaha ki desh aur rajy ki seva men apna pura jivan khapa dene vale varishth netaon ke khilaph is tarah ki maryada se girkar halki tippani karna kangres ki naee karyasanskriti ban gaee hai.
